title: Can't get past objective 1 in fresh AAPS install with NSClientV3
symptom: In a fresh AAPS 3.2.0.3 install with NSClientV3 configured and all uploads enabled, blood glucose is uploaded to Nightscout but the objective regarding this does not get completed.
cause: The issue is caused by using NSClientV3; the objective completion check does not work with NSClientV3.
fix: Workaround: switch to NSClientV1 to complete the objective, then switch back to NSClientV3. The issue was later fixed by a commit.
evidence_quote: Workaround is to select NSClientV1, then objective gets completed.
